acceptance: The harness records a digest of go/acs/cycle<N> at the TDD handoff in a record that no phase profile can write
The audit refuses a predicate package whose digest differs from the TDD record, unless a named repair path rebinds it
A test: a build that rewrites a predicate through its shell gets a FAIL that names the file
docs/architecture/gate-input-inventory.md reclassifies the row from open-seam to verified, and TestGateInputInventory_TheOpenSeamsArePinned drops it from the pinned list
fix: Bind the predicate package at the TDD handoff (a ledger entry with the tree SHA of go/acs/cycle<N>) and check it in prepareEvidence before the suite runs.
summary: Open seam 1 of the gate input inventory (verifier-isolation-audit). The builder profile denies Edit and Write on go/acs/**, but its sandbox grants the whole worktree, so a shell command can rewrite the TDD predicates. The audit runs the predicates on disk, and nothing records them at the TDD handoff.
title: The audit runs TDD predicates that the build can rewrite through its shell; freeze them at the TDD handoff
